lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Tuesday's BOCC meeting, where county commissioners take up two Land Use Code amendments — one on Natural Medicine Businesses and one on Nonconforming Lots — the kind of code language that quietly determines what gets built and where for years to come. Wednesday brings three separate public hearings at HARC on the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave, a large-scale project covering multiple new buildings in Backman Village. HARC also reviews alterations to Town Hall and the Parks & Rec office on Tuesday, and Monday afternoon the Open Space Commission hosts a Valley Floor weed pull with public comment open to anyone who shows up.

notable.stake: Public hearings on large-scale Carhenge redevelopment, multiple new buildings in Backman Village.
HARC reviews alterations and a floor-area addition to two Town-owned landmark buildings.
BOCC votes on Land Use Code amendments affecting Natural Medicine Businesses and Nonconforming Lots.
Valley Floor site walk includes open public comment opportunity.
